allow:
Bash(git commit -m "$(cat <<''EOF''
Fix mobile scroll in dialogs by capping height and enabling internal scroll

DialogContent used fixed centering with translate-y-[-50%] and no max-height,
so tall forms (e.g. ProductDialog with 9 fields) overflowed the viewport on
mobile and could not be scrolled because body scroll was locked by Radix.

Adding max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto to the className makes the dialog
itself scroll internally, so every Radix dialog in the app (Products,
Members, ChitPayments, Receipts, Confirm dialogs) is now usable on phones.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)")
